subject.title: Feature: Trigger model fallback on context length exceeded

question: Should exhausted context overflow enter the configured model fallback chain when a later candidate has verified context headroom, or must overflow remain compaction-only?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally separates overflow recovery from model failover, and changing it requires an explicit policy for replay safety, automatic session persistence, provider transitions, and unknown context metadata.

options.title: Guarded larger-context fallback
options.body: After compaction and truncation fail, retry only replay-safe runs on configured candidates with verified sufficient context and use the existing automatic-fallback lifecycle.

options.title: Keep compaction-only behavior
options.body: Continue returning a blocked overflow result and document that users must compact, reset, or explicitly switch models.

options.title: Fallback for one turn
options.body: Try a verified larger candidate for the current turn without persisting the model change unless the user explicitly switches.

recommendation.title: Guarded larger-context fallback
recommendation.body: After compaction and truncation fail, retry only replay-safe runs on configured candidates with verified sufficient context and use the existing automatic-fallback lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent history across the affected fallback and compaction paths and already reviewed this exact product boundary in the issue discussion.
